title: Palette assignment (v1)
description: Per-stem palette assignment authored by cycle 31 Branch B (M-DAW-SPIKE-1/palette-assignment-schema). One row per {stem, instrument} decision; cycle 32's bare-render implementation will iterate the batch and dispatch to the named instrument with the pinned_state parameters. Content-addressed assignment_id (UUID5 hex) guarantees deterministic reproduction. additionalProperties: false at every object level.

assignment_id.description: UUID5 hex (32 lowercase hex chars) derived from canonical-JSON of (schema_v, stem, instrument, pinned_state, sorted(provenance_pointers), extractor_version). notes_optional is EXCLUDED from the hash.

stem.description: Which stem this assignment addresses. Matches htdemucs stem taxonomy minus vocals (out-of-scope for this branch).

instrument.description: Instrument palette identifier. surge_xt/dexed = VST3; sfizz = SFZ sampler; fluidsynth_gm = legacy GM soundfont chain.

external_state_sha_optional.description: SHA-256 of any external state file (e.g. SFZ patch, DX7 sysex) that the plugin loads. Optional; when present must be 64 lowercase hex chars.

items.description: rule_id string that MUST resolve against data/rules/ledger.jsonl OR data/rules/ledger_i3_dminor.jsonl (checked by Layer 2 validator).

notes_optional.description: Free-text authoring note. EXCLUDED from assignment_id hash to allow note edits without invalidating the id.
